no_raw_ids.rule: No manifest, header, bootstrap file or register may contain a raw source identifier string. Only integer handles, the decision_id surrogate, and the salted pseudonym client_key_hex are allowed.
no_raw_ids.allowed_string_columns: Only the enum-typed columns declared in 'enums', plus client_key_hex (exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters).
no_raw_ids.build_check: The builder fails if a column name is in forbidden_columns, if any string column is neither enum-typed nor client_key_hex, if an enum value is unregistered, or if a client_key_hex value fails the pattern ^[0-9a-f]{64}$.
no_raw_ids.note_client_idx: client_idx is forbidden as a column because it is the shared OOV token 2 for TRAIN-absent users (G0/feature_map/FEATURE_LOCALITY_MAP.md L178-L182). It is never an identity (CLIENT_CONTRACT_V1 C1.3).
source: V4/OWNER_SCOPE_V4.md constraints: no raw user IDs in shared reports

identity.selection_key: int.from_bytes(sha256(b'PPSI_V4_POPULATION_20260926' + b'|' + user_id.encode('utf-8')).digest()[:8], 'big'), i.e. the first 16 hex characters of client_key_hex read as unsigned 64-bit big-endian; stored as uint64
identity.uniqueness: Within every manifest, and across the union of all manifests built so far, the count of distinct client_key_hex must equal the count of distinct user_id strings. Any collision is fatal. No two users of the universe U may share a selection_key; if they do, BLOCK and escalate.
identity.client_ord_and_eval_user_key: 0-based dense rank of client_key_hex in ascending order, among the users present in that manifest; int64. Named client_ord in TRAIN manifests and eval_user_key in evaluation manifests. Cross-manifest joins use client_key_hex only.

timestamps.encoding: int64 microseconds since 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z (UTC), converted exactly from the ledger timestamp, with a round-trip assertion
timestamps.nulls: forbidden in every column; sentinels only
timestamps.bounds_us_note: Split bounds are the half-open UTC intervals of EVALUATION_CONTRACT_V4 section 1.1 (PKG/03 section 2 L9-L13).

ordering.train_manifests: clients table ascending client_ord; decisions table ascending (client_ord, decision_id), so each client's rows form one contiguous range (PKG/12 T23 L32)
ordering.central_canonical_order: ascending decision_id (GRU1 FULL_RUN_PROTOCOL.md L33), stored as a derived permutation with its own sha256
ordering.evaluation_manifests: decisions table ascending decision_id (canonical order, GRU1 FULL_RUN_PROTOCOL.md L33, L61); users table ascending eval_user_key
ordering.cold_h_tables: panel_queries ascending (panel_type enum order, h, eval_user_key); panel_support ascending (panel_type, h, eval_user_key, support_decision_id)

hashing.table_content_sha256: sha256 over, for each column in the declared field order: uint32 little-endian byte length of the column name, the UTF-8 column name, one uint8 dtype code (1 int64, 2 uint64, 3 int32, 4 int8, 5 bool as uint8 0/1, 6 string), then the column payload in manifest row order. Fixed-width values are contiguous little-endian bytes. Each string value is a uint32 little-endian byte length followed by its UTF-8 bytes. The hash is independent of the Parquet writer.
hashing.ordered_decision_id_sha256: sha256 over the int64 little-endian decision_id column, all rows, in manifest order
hashing.eval_ordered_decision_id_sha256: the same, restricted to rows with eval_mask = true. This is the RESULT_ROW query_order_hash (PKG/templates/RESULT_ROW.template.json L11) and the prediction alignment key (PKG/09 section 1 L6).
hashing.rankable_ordered_decision_id_sha256: the same, restricted to rows with rankable = true. T35 uses it to prove the rankable sets are identical across methods.
hashing.population_sha256: sha256 over the concatenation of each selected user's 8-byte big-endian selection_key, in ascending key order (the definition of CEN/COHORT_PROJECTIONS.json L5)
hashing.user_set_sha256: sha256 over the concatenated 32-byte digests (client_key_hex decoded), in ascending order, of the users in a given evaluated user set; identifies a bootstrap W
hashing.candidate_order_hash: sha256 over, for output_class = 0..K-1 ascending: the int64 little-endian output_class, the uint32 little-endian byte length of product_id, then the product_id UTF-8 bytes, read from the frozen catalogue. It binds the class order that the tie rule depends on (EVALUATION_CONTRACT_V4 E6.1).
hashing.file_sha256: sha256 of the written file bytes; integrity only, not identity
hashing.forbidden: Python hash(), delimiter-joined identifier strings, and float-encoded identifiers (PKG/03 section 1 L5; DS1/DATA_CONTRACT.md L188-L193)

file_format.atomicity: write to a temporary file, fsync, verify the hashes, then rename. The success marker <manifest_id>.OK is written last and only after verification (PKG/12 T45 L58, T46 L59).
file_format.location: V4/manifests/ locally and on the server (PENDING: Operations Director)

counts_by_cause.rule: Every manifest header carries counts by cause (PKG/03 section 9 L50).

enums.target_status_source: CEN/CENSUS_README.md L121-L126 (values). Code-derived definitions: pipeline5.py:122-132, quoted in QA1/BOUNDARY_DEFINITIONS.md L49-L60 and L73-L113. NO_OBSERVED_NEXT, AMBIGUOUS_BOUNDARY and BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED have target_product_id NULL, so has_observed_target, loss_mask and eval_mask are FALSE and target_class = -1 in every split (pipeline6.py:386-404; BOUNDARY_DEFINITIONS.md L115-L153).
enums.next_block_type_note: The three block types are code-defined at pipeline4.py:78-81 (QA1/BOUNDARY_DEFINITIONS.md L17-L34). NONE means there is no next raw block (next_block_ts IS NULL). INVALID_PRODUCT_BARRIER never pairs with AMBIGUOUS_BOUNDARY in this dataset (BOUNDARY_DEFINITIONS.md L171-L172). Any other value stops the build.
enums.censor_class_rules: EVALUATION_CONTRACT_V4 section 2.2 (R2) and E2.1. CEN_NO_NEXT: status NO_OBSERVED_NEXT. CEN_LEGACY_BARRIER: status BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED, old split VALIDATION_SELECT, next_split VALIDATION_CONFIRM. CEN_RIGHT_EDGE: status BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED with next_split TEST or LABEL_GRACE. CEN_AMBIGUOUS_NEXT_BARRIER: every AMBIGUOUS_BOUNDARY row, including the 140 VS->VC rows (REV/G0B_PROTOCOL_FABLE_POSITION.md C5 L22). Precedence unchanged: CEN_LEGACY_BARRIER > CEN_RIGHT_EDGE > CEN_AMBIGUOUS_NEXT_BARRIER > CEN_NO_NEXT. NONE iff eval_mask = true.

decision_id.definition: Derived surrogate source_file_id * 1e11 + source_row_number; not a source or user identifier

client_key_hex.definition: Salted full sha256 pseudonym of user_id

selection_key.definition: First 8 bytes of the client_key_hex digest, big-endian

client_ord.definition: Dense rank of client_key_hex within a TRAIN manifest

eval_user_key.definition: Dense rank of client_key_hex within an evaluation manifest; the macro and bootstrap grouping key

target_ts_us.definition: Observed target time, UTC microseconds; -1 if there is no observed target

old_split.definition: Split label in the frozen ledger

v4_split.definition: V4 split by half-open UTC bounds on decision_ts

subperiod.definition: VAL_A for VALIDATION decisions in [2019-11-16, 2019-11-20); VAL_B for [2019-11-20, 2019-11-23); otherwise NONE

next_split.definition: Ledger split of the next block; NONE if there is none

next_block_type.definition: Ledger type of the next block; NONE if there is none

eval_mask.definition: Frozen ledger eval mask; measured equal to has_observed_target in future partitions

target_class.definition: Compact output class 0..158485, or -1 when there is no rankable target

target_train_support.definition: TRAIN support count of the target product (TRAIN ledger rows with that product as the context item); -1 if there is no observed target

oov_cause.definition: ABSENT_FROM_TRAIN if target_oov and support = 0; BELOW_SUPPORT if target_oov and 1 <= support <= 4; NONE if the target is rankable; NOT_APPLICABLE if there is no observed target

target_class_cohort_train_positives.definition: Number of cohort-TRAIN eligible examples whose target_class equals this row's target_class, counted over M01 (or M05 for calibration manifests); -1 if the row is not rankable. Diagnostic only: identifies ranked classes that no cohort client trained on.

censor_class.definition: Censoring class for rows with eval_mask = false; NONE otherwise

target_category_state.definition: Category token state of the target product under the frozen end-of-TRAIN metadata snapshot; NOT_APPLICABLE if there is no observed target

cold_stratum.definition: WARM if >= 1 eligible TRAIN example; COLD_NO_TRAIN_EVENTS if 0 TRAIN ledger rows; COLD_TRAIN_EVENTS_NO_LABEL if >= 1 TRAIN ledger row and 0 eligible examples

in_calib_prefix.definition: User is among the 65,536 smallest selection keys
